statement:
∀ (n m : ℤ),
  ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, Complex.exp (↑n * ↑x * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (-(↑m * ↑x * Complex.I)) =
    ↑(if n = m then 2 * π else 0)
